subject: Recap + MAP draft: ACME POC environment dependencies
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <s.desai@acme.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + MAP draft: ACME POC environment dependencies

Hi Samir / team,

Thanks again for the call earlier - great alignment on scope. Per our discussion I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the POC milestones. Highlighting the immediate milestone we discussed: POC environment setup dependencies. Please review and confirm owners/timing so we can lock the POC start window.

POC environment setup (milestone - dependencies & asks):
- VPC peering / routing: ACME to approve peering (vpc-abc123) and provide expected CIDR ranges; Redwood will initiate peering and provide test endpoints. Target: complete by 2026-12-15. Owner: ACME IT / Redwood.
- IP allowlist: ACME to add Redwood egress IPs (listed below) to firewall. If ACME prefers, we can use customer static egress or a VPX NAT. Owner: ACME IT.
- SSO / SAML: ACME to provide IdP metadata (entityID, certificate, ACS URLs). Redwood will provide SP metadata and test account. Owner: ACME IT / Redwood. Target: metadata exchange by 2026-12-04.
- Secrets / KMS: Clarify key management: customer-managed KMS recommended (AWS KMS key id) for production; Redwood can manage temporary test secrets for POC. Owner: ACME Security / Redwood Cloud Ops.
- Service accounts & IAM: ACME to create a service account and grant network permissions for peering/testing.

Dependencies / blockers:
- Security approval for peering + firewall change window (please confirm available windows).
- SAML metadata from ACME to validate SSO flows.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (attached) - this includes a milestone table with responsibilities and proposed target close dates.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm the SAML contact and whether metadata is available by Fri 12/4?
2) Can you confirm firewall windows for adding IP allowlist (suggested: 12/08-12/09)?
3) Redwood will circulate a short infra checklist for the peering/egress setup by EOD tomorrow.

If ok, I will update the MAP with the confirmed dates and owners and share MAP-draft-v2.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 128KB)

Thanks Marissa - quick internal notes (looping in Priyom for infra):
- For SAML we will need the IdP entityID and the signing cert (public) to generate the SP metadata and validate assertions. If ACME can share metadata.xml that's ideal.
- For IP allowlist: do you have static egress IPs we should plan for, or do you prefer us to use customer-managed NAT/egress?
- Priyom: I will coordinate the peering steps and provide a minimal checklist (route tables, security groups, test endpoints).

Samir, can you confirm the above and share the SAML file if available?

Thanks - Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma

Hi Marissa / Nikhil,

Thanks for the clear recap - we are aligned on the MAP items. A few data points from our side:
- SAML metadata: attaching our metadata file (acme_saml_metadata.xml). Our SSO owner is Priya Menon (priya.menon@acme.com) if you need to coordinate certificate rotations.
- IP ranges for allowlist: 52.23.14.0/24, 18.197.45.0/24, additional egress may be via NAT; we will confirm static egress by end of day.
- KMS: For production we prefer customer-managed AWS KMS (key id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234). For the POC, ACME security ok'd temporary Redwood-managed secrets, but we'll expect key handover for production.
- Firewall change window: our infra team can open rules during 2026-12-08 02:00-06:00 UTC or 2026-12-09 22:00-02:00 UTC. Please pick a window.

Target dates: we are comfortable aiming for POC environment readiness by 2026-12-20 (ACME prefers a slightly later baseline).

Attachment: acme_saml_metadata.xml (application/xml)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP draft: ACME POC environment dependencies (updated)

Thanks Samir - really helpful. I updated the MAP with your inputs and a proposed schedule. Attaching MAP-draft-v2 with the milestone table. Summary of updated MAP (milestone / owner / target):

- Exchange SAML metadata / IdP cert: ACME IT (Priya Menon) - target 2026-12-04 (DONE when metadata provided).
- Firewall / IP allowlist: ACME IT - target window 2026-12-08 02:00-06:00 UTC (ACME confirmed).
- VPC peering and route config: ACME IT + Redwood Cloud Ops - target 2026-12-15. Redwood will create peering request on 2026-12-06 and validate routes.
- Secrets & KMS for POC: Redwood will use managed secrets for POC; production to be migrated to customer-managed AWS KMS (ACME key id provided). Target for production handover: 2027-01-10.
- Test SSO login & smoke tests: Redwood QA - target 2026-12-16.

Next steps (action owners):
1) Redwood (Priyom): share infra checklist and peering request template by 2026-12-04.
2) ACME (Priya): confirm firewall change window and static egress by 2026-12-06.
3) Marissa: update MAP in HubSpot and schedule a 30-min sync for 2026-12-07 to review final schedule.

I scheduled the sync for Tue 2026-12-07 11:00 PST - calendar invite to follow. If any of the target dates need to move, flag now and we'll adjust the MAP.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v2.pdf (application/pdf, 145KB)

Appreciate the quick turnaround - excited to get the POC going.
